dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is back above $0.40 and up over 90% from this morning's low. I'm pretty sure this isn't over yet.

To put it another way: While there are big differences between, say, Dogecoin and Ethereum in terms of utility and potential, those differences have no bearing on the trading decisions of many of those who recently piled into cryptos because they saw others make money doing so.

One near-term issue with higher-quality cryptos (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Chainlink, etc.) is that cryptos overall have become highly price-correlated due to recent speculative buying.

That makes it hard for higher-quality stuff to be spared as the likes of Dogecoin see a reckoning. https://t.co/MzTFrxTIAs
One possible sign that the latest frenzy is nearing its end: $TSLA is down 3.3% today. Wouldn't be surprised if many retail investors have been selling it to buy meme stocks, Dogecoin, etc.
